metadata.name: Matt Pocock Skills Full Example
metadata.description: Full bundle of the 25 stable Skills published by github.com/mattpocock/skills at commit 8b78b531ab965735c5dc74f6f7a219e1e37326df (upstream plugin version 1.2.3)

agent_skills.name: Ask Matt
agent_skills.description: Ask which skill or flow fits your situation. A router over the skills in this repo.

agent_skills.name: Diagnosing Bugs
agent_skills.description: Diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions. Use when the user says "diagnose"/"debug this", or reports something broken/throwing/failing/slow.

agent_skills.name: Grill with Docs
agent_skills.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design, which also creates docs (ADR's and glossary) as we go.

agent_skills.name: Triage
agent_skills.description: Move issues and external PRs through a state machine of triage roles — categorise, verify, grill if needed, and write agent-ready briefs.

agent_skills.name: Improve Codebase Architecture
agent_skills.description: Scan a codebase for deepening opportunities, present them as a visual HTML report, then grill through whichever one you pick.

agent_skills.name: Setup Matt Pocock Skills
agent_skills.description: Configure this repo for the engineering skills — set up its issue tracker, triage label vocabulary, and domain doc layout. Run once before first use of the other engineering skills.

agent_skills.name: TDD
agent_skills.description: Test-driven development. Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions "red-green-refactor", or wants integration tests.

agent_skills.name: To Spec
agent_skills.description: Turn the current conversation into a spec and publish it to the project issue tracker — no interview, just synthesis of what you've already discussed.

agent_skills.name: To Tickets
agent_skills.description: Break a plan, spec, or the current conversation into a set of tracer-bullet tickets, each declaring its blocking edges, published to the configured tracker — edges as text in one file per ticket locally, or native blocking links on a real tracker.

agent_skills.name: Wayfinder
agent_skills.description: Plan a huge chunk of work — more than one agent session can hold — as a shared map of decision tickets on your issue tracker, and resolve them one at a time until the way to the destination is clear.

agent_skills.name: Implement
agent_skills.description: Implement a piece of work based on a spec or set of tickets.

agent_skills.name: Prototype
agent_skills.description: Build a throwaway prototype to answer a design question. Use when the user wants to sanity-check whether a state model or logic feels right, or explore what a UI should look like.

agent_skills.name: Research
agent_skills.description: Investigate a question against high-trust primary sources and capture the findings as a Markdown file in the repo. Use when the user wants a topic researched, docs or API facts gathered, or reading legwork delegated to a background agent.

agent_skills.name: Domain Modeling
agent_skills.description: Build and sharpen a project's domain model. Use when discussing codebase terminology, writing or editing a CONTEXT.md, or recording or editing an ADR.

agent_skills.name: Codebase Design
agent_skills.description: Shared vocabulary for designing deep modules. Use when the user wants to design or improve a module's interface, find deepening opportunities, decide where a seam goes, make code more testable or AI-navigable, or when another skill needs the deep-module vocabulary.

agent_skills.name: Code Review
agent_skills.description: Review the changes since a fixed point (commit, branch, tag, or merge-base) along two axes — Standards (does the code follow this repo's documented coding standards?) and Spec (does the code match what the originating issue/spec asked for?). Runs both reviews in parallel sub-agents and reports them side by side. Use when the user wants to review a branch, a PR, work-in-progress changes, or asks to "review since X".

agent_skills.name: Resolving Merge Conflicts
agent_skills.description: Use when you need to resolve an in-progress git merge/rebase conflict.

agent_skills.name: Wizard
agent_skills.description: Generate an interactive bash wizard that walks a human through steps only they can perform. Use when provisioning infrastructure, setting up credentials or CI secrets, walking an unfamiliar third-party dashboard, or running a one-off migration or cutover. Don't invoke this for steps the agent can perform itself.

agent_skills.name: Grill Me
agent_skills.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design.

agent_skills.name: Grilling
agent_skills.description: Grill the user relentlessly about a plan, decision, or idea. Use when the user wants to stress-test their thinking, or uses any 'grill' trigger phrases.

agent_skills.name: Handoff
agent_skills.description: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up.

agent_skills.name: Teach
agent_skills.description: Teach the user a new skill or concept, within this workspace.

agent_skills.name: To Questionnaire
agent_skills.description: Turn a decision you can't fully answer into a questionnaire for someone else to fill in.

agent_skills.name: Wait What
agent_skills.description: Stop. That last message did not land — re-pitch it.

agent_skills.name: Writing for Agents
agent_skills.description: Writing documents for agents. Use when creating or editing skills, or modifying AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md.
